records.name: TruAstra
records.tagline: Small practices based on your birthday + the current weather
records.description: The sky sets the weather. You set the day. TruAstra computes your sidereal Vedic birth chart offline with the JPL DE440 engine on truastra.com and iPhone. When the sky scores your day low (like 34), three small daily practices (+3 each) visibly lift your day to 43. Every number opens inline to show its exact recorded planetary factor. Includes a live 9-planet sky dial with date jumps, 7-day curve, Dasha timing, Home and Lock Screen widgets, and an iPhone App Clip. 100% Free.

records.name: Koed
records.tagline: Supercharged Agents!
records.description: Koed gives each coding project its own Kin: a customisable assistant that remembers how you like to work, the decisions you’ve made and what you’ve already tried. Your Kin reasons over that context to give Claude Code, Codex and Pi guidance shaped by your project, helping your agents work faster and use fewer tokens. Koed runs on-device and is free and open source. It’s available now for solo developers, with more coding agent integrations, optional cloud processing and team sharing coming soon.

records.name: Fompi
records.tagline: Personal security & privacy companion that calls out risks
records.description: Fompi sits quietly in your browser and on your Mac, and speaks up when it matters: a scam page, a phishing email, a disguised download, an AI notetaker in your call, an app on your mic, a card number headed for an AI chat. It tells you why. Free to start :)

records.name: Canva MCP
records.tagline: Turn any AI agent into a creative powerhouse
records.description: Canva MCP opens Canva's creative tools to AI agents and developers. Generate editable designs, images and videos, remove backgrounds, resize assets and automate on-brand creative workflows with MCP, REST APIs and CLI.

records.name: eluna
records.tagline: Period tracker for couples that explains WHY, not just WHEN
records.description: most period trackers are a calendar with a countdown. eluna tells you WHY. a one minute check in and it writes a line from her own data: why day 24 feels heavy, why the bloating is back, what's coming next. ask eluna anything and it answers from her history, not a leaflet. then the part made for couples: partner mode gives him a heads up before the harder days, not after the fight. iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Watch, 7 languages, free to start, built by a husband and wife

records.name: Airbot
records.tagline: The AI chief of staff that texts you first
records.description: Most AI assistants wait for you to ask. Airbot texts you first. It checks the conversations, meetings, and customer updates spread across email, Slack, your calendar, and CRM, then brings you only the priorities that matter. Behind every message is work already prepared: a drafted response, a meeting brief, a booking, or a CRM change. Approve what should happen directly in WhatsApp or iMessage. Airbot helps founders and lean teams stay on top of work without living in their notifications.

records.name: Hiring Right Now
records.tagline: Which startups would hire you?
records.description: Paste your LinkedIn. Backdoor reads your work, searches growing startups and shows you the ones that fit, the founder to write to, and the email to send them. Free, no signup required, takes about two minutes.

records.name: MyClaw 3.0
records.tagline: Build an always-on AI team with shared memory
records.description: MyClaw lets you build your own AI team with OpenClaw, Claude Code, Codex, Hermes Agent, Pi, and more. Give each teammate its own role, tools, skills, and choice of 50+ models, with shared memory across your team. Your agents run on always-on cloud computers, use your apps, access data, and handle recurring tasks even when you're offline. Assign work from the web, Slack, Telegram, or WhatsApp. No server setup or lock-in to a single AI provider.

records.name: Hold'em
records.tagline: Swipe real Black Friday cart deals across Shopify
records.description: Black Friday online is mostly 40 open tabs and fake markdowns. Hold'em turns deal hunting into a card game across Shopify, checking live store carts for real automatic discounts and putting your keepers in one pack.

records.name: CodeRabbit Verify
records.tagline: AI agent that tests your running app on every pull request
records.description: CodeRabbit Verify is an agentic testing feature that runs your actual app in a sandbox and catches functional bugs before customers do. It builds test scenarios from a pull request, runs plain-English regression journeys on demand or on a schedule, and posts results with recordings, screenshots and logs. Findings can go to CodeRabbit Agent or another coding agent for a fix, or into Jira or Linear. Public beta: test runs are free.

records.name: PartGenie 2.0
records.tagline: The AI workspace for hardware engineering
records.description: PartGenie is the AI workspace for hardware engineering, connecting design, component intelligence, sourcing, and manufacturing in one place. Explore 60M+ electronic components, get datasheet-grounded answers, find verified alternatives & ECAD models, analyze BOMs, and move from engineering decisions to real-world sourcing and PCB/PCBA manufacturing. From design to build. Anywhere.

records.name: Continual-ARC
records.tagline: OpenClaw doesn't learn from experience. Does your agent?
records.description: Left to themselves, OpenClaw, Hermes Agent and Prime Agent failed to memorize puzzles they'd already seen, and didn't get better at solving new ones. In contrast, a small 9B model trained on the same stream got better at both. Run yours on the open benchmark.

records.name: Hai
records.tagline: Your AI assistant that actually makes the phone call
records.description: Some bookings still only happen by phone, and plenty of us dread making that call. For people who are deaf, hard of hearing, or have speech or anxiety barriers, that call can be impossible. Hai makes it for you. Tell your assistant what you need, approve the plan, and Hai places the call in any language to any business that takes bookings by phone, then reports back in text. Free to start. Built by an indie developer in Japan.

records.name: RelayRunner
records.tagline: Swap between CI runners on-demand with zero code changes.
records.description: RelayRunner is a router for your existing CI runners, so you can use multiple providers or self-hosted options at the same time. Send each GitHub Actions job to the first free runner in your order: your own Mac, self-hosted runners, GitHub's default runners, or providers like Blacksmith and Boat. Change the order any time without touching your workflows. Open source, with a Mac app and a CLI that turn any machine into a runner on-demand.

records.name: 3way.Social MCP
records.tagline: Ask your AI to find link partners. You approve the deals.
records.description: 3way.Social is a fair, credit-based marketplace for link insertions and guest posts, with no cold outreach. Each site chooses what it buys and sells, links are priced on industry-standard metrics (DR, traffic, spam score), and if a link disappears you get your credits back. AI discovery finds specific pages on your topic, not just domains. The MCP brings it into Claude, Cursor or ChatGPT: ask for partner pages for your new post, then approve the deal.

records.name: Falcon by Vybe
records.tagline: Falcon analyzes your competitors for free, then gets to work
records.description: Get a free competitor analysis. Falcon, a Vybe agent, digs into your rivals and delivers a deep report: market landscape, feature parity, momentum, gaps left open, and competitors' go-to-market motions. The whole picture, not just a list of competitors. Want more than the report? Falcon runs on Vybe, so you can let an agent take the wheel, keep you updated on where the market is headed and turn the findings into work.

records.name: Tendeck
records.tagline: Run all your Claude Code and Codex agents on one Mac board
records.description: Every coding agent becomes a card on one board. The card turns gold when an agent needs you, so nothing waits 40 minutes for a "yes". Claude Code, Codex or any agent CLI, with worktrees, account switching and files on the card. $59 once.

records.name: Tray
records.tagline: macOS file manager in a screen corner
records.description: A file manager for macOS that lives in a screen corner. Drop files on the shelf, preview them, group them into a folder, drag them anywhere, or send them to the Bin — without opening Finder.

records.name: VibeCode.surf
records.tagline: AI code editor where agents build, run and test your app
records.description: VibeCode.surf is an AI code editor for your desktop. Several agents plan, write, run and test your code on your own computer, with any model. Say what you want, and a lead agent splits the job across helpers that write the code, run it and test it in a real browser. It runs on your computer with any model, from Claude and GPT to a local one, and shows what every reply costs.

records.name: Blink
records.tagline: Describe any trade and watch Blink build it
records.description: "If they announce Jensen is back, long NVDA and short AMD." The news that moves a stock usually lands while you're asleep or in a meeting, and by the time you see it the move is over. Blink is a trading app where you describe any trade in plain English and it builds it, then watches around the clock. It can trigger on a post on X, a headline, an earnings result, a line said on a live earnings call or a shift in prediction market odds, and it places the trade the moment it happens.

records.name: MemoryWorks
records.tagline: Company memory for people and AI agents

Works with ChatGPT and Claude Code via an MCP server. Open source (AGPL-3.0).

records.name: OpenEight
records.tagline: The deterministic control layer for AI agents

Trace each decision to its reported outcome and export evidence anyone can independently verify.

records.name: SteerLatch

It's proactive: set a goal or a schedule and it runs the task to the end, asking only when a decision or risky action needs you. Your files stay on your machine. Free and open-source. Bring your own model — cloud or local — the assistant and its autonomy are the product.

Review the changes and merge from your computer or your phone. It works with the subscription or API key you already pay for.

records.description: Let any AI agent use your computer while you see every step and can stop it. A local MCP server with approvals, verified actions and an audit log.

records.name: Number Bumper

records.description: Number Bumper is a free Android number puzzle made by a solo developer. Find pairs that make 10, compete in live weekly tournaments, raise your pet Bumperling, and chat with other players. No purchases; ads appear only if you choose to watch one.

records.name: Dopia
records.tagline: An AI sales agent and a CRM that updates itself
records.description: Dopia answers every lead on your website chat, phone and email, then keeps contacts and deals up to date from every call, chat, email and meeting, so no one types notes into a CRM. Desktop apps for macOS and Windows record meetings without a bot. Free plan.

records.name: Flowlist
records.tagline: Daily notes that turn into a prioritised task list
records.description: Flowlist turns your daily notes into a sorted task list. Write the way you think: it pulls out the tasks, sets priority, due dates and tags with a reason, and checks your calendar. Free sorts on your device; Pro adds AI sorting, free during the beta.

records.name: Block Puzzle Pro: ColorFit
records.tagline: Fit colorful blocks into picture puzzles, free with no ads
records.description: A calm puzzle game: drag colorful blocks into picture outlines like a star, a fish or a dragon until they're full. 35 hand-made puzzles from easy to Master, unlimited free hints, undo, and offline play. No ads, no in-app purchases, no sign-up, no data collected.

records.name: Starkeep
records.tagline: Bookmarks that keep a private copy of the page
records.description: Links die, and your bookmarks die with them. Starkeep saves a private copy of the page as clean text, a PDF, and a thumbnail, so it still opens when the original is gone. Search the full text of everything you kept, save pages behind a login with the Chrome extension, and let Claude or another assistant search your library over MCP. Free for 100 bookmarks and 10 archived pages a month, or $5 a month for more.

records.name: Kumoo
records.tagline: Speed up your photo editing with batch retouching
records.description: Kumoo, created by Meitu, is a powerful desktop photo editor that brings pro-studio retouching to everyone with zero learning curve. Designed for studios and quality-driven creators, our smart tools make batch editing 10x faster while preserving flawless, natural skin textures. Achieve magazine-quality results instantly with tethered shooting, auto-selection, 1-click portrait retouching, auto color grading, and seamless object removal!

records.name: Unmentioned
records.tagline: The pages AI recommends from, and the work to get on them
records.description: AI visibility dashboards tell you that ChatGPT doesn't mention you. Unmentioned tells you why, and hands you the fix. It asks ChatGPT, Claude and Perplexity your buyers' real questions, scores you against the brands they recommend instead, and finds the pages those answers come from. Then it writes the plan to get on them: emails to list authors, forum replies, directory profiles and page outlines. A report you act on, not a dashboard you watch. Free preview, then one payment.

records.name: Tendeck
records.tagline: Run all your Claude Code and Codex agents on one Mac board
records.description: Every coding agent becomes a card on one board. The card turns gold when an agent needs you, so nothing waits 40 minutes for a "yes". Claude Code, Codex or any agent CLI, with worktrees, account switching and files on the card. $59 once.

records.name: The Ninth Wonder of the World
records.tagline: Your eyes to the world — 547 live cams, sports & games
records.description: Your eyes to the world — 547 verified-live webcams from 358 places in 78 countries, live sports scores across 30 feeds, fantasy with tappable buttons, points-only play, 623 playable games, and 633 original movies, sitcoms and shows in 92 themed Experiences.

records.name: llms.txt & AI Crawler Studio
records.tagline: Build & lint llms.txt + 45-bot AI robots.txt in-browser
records.description: Generate, lint, and auto-fix llms.txt, llms-full.txt, and RFC 9309-safe AI robots.txt locally in your browser. Includes a 12-point validator, BPE token budgets, 45-bot governance presets, HTML-to-Markdown cleanup, and 10 deployment exports.

records.name: GibHub
records.tagline: Retrieve and compare Git versions
records.description: GibHub — Git File History for Xcode Projects Git is an essential version control system for software development teams and solo developers alike. It allows you to track changes, maintain a history of your work, and return to previous versions when needed. Desktop applications such as GitHub Desktop and Sourcetree make Git easier to use.

records.name: MAGI-2
records.tagline: Sand AI's 480B model for cinematic video generation
records.description: MAGI-2 is Sand AI's flagship video generation model, creating up to 30 seconds of 1080p video with synchronized native audio. Combine up to 20 image, video, and audio references to guide characters, scenes, styles, and sound. Direct shot changes and timeline events, or edit specific parts of existing videos. Built for creators who want more control over cinematic AI video production. Available through the Sand AI platform and API.

records.name: file.spot
records.tagline: File transfer for creative professionals
records.description: Share large files with clients on a delivery page in your own branding. Previews of every file, five layouts, and no account needed to download. Stored in the EU, no ads, and your work is never used for AI training.

records.name: Prop Firm Position Sizer
records.tagline: Size futures contracts to your risk and stop on TradingView
records.description: An open-source TradingView indicator that works out how many futures contracts fit a chosen risk amount and stop distance. Set the risk as a percent of the account or a fixed dollar amount, and the stop in points, ticks or a multiple of ATR. The count is rounded down, so the actual risk stays at or below the budget, and an optional cap keeps it within the contract limit of the account. Long and short stop levels are drawn from the entry price. It places no orders.

records.name: SteerLatch
records.tagline: Connect MCP-compatible AIs to your computer
records.description: SteerLatch connects MCP-compatible AIs to your authorized Mac/Windows PC: files, desktop, terminal, STOP and revocable access. NEW: control your paired PC from a phone/browser after local setup, while AI works. SteerLatch Context Hub shares project memory and messages across agents. Official apps are live on Apple App Store (iPhone companion) and Microsoft Store (Windows). Free 3-month trial: 3 PCs, 5,000 MCP calls/month, no card.

records.name: OpenEight
records.tagline: The deterministic control layer for AI agents
records.description: OpenEight helps teams trust AI agents with real work. Build with the SDK or connect an existing agent, then set policies for which tool calls can run, which need human approval, and which are blocked. Trace each decision to its reported outcome and export evidence anyone can independently verify.

records.name: The Fare Room
records.tagline: UK Flights, Business Class Fares and Tailor-Made Holidays
records.description: The Fare Room helps UK travellers explore international flight deals, economy, premium economy and business class fares, and tailor-made holiday packages. Travellers can enquire about flight options, compare available fares and plan journeys to destinations worldwide.

records.name: Communication & Presentation
records.tagline: Build sharper slides, talks and pitches
records.description: AI agent skills for presentation storytelling, slide design, delivery, data storytelling, pitch presentations, persuasive communication and audience-focused messaging. - afeezadebayo/communication-...

records.name: SquareCount
records.tagline: Counter widgets that live on your iPhone Home Screen
records.description: SquareCount puts a counter on your iPhone Home Screen. Tap +10 after a set of pull-ups, or Espresso after a coffee, and it's logged. You never have to open the app. A tracker counts an amount or counts by kind, in small, medium or large widgets, light or dark. Free with one tracker. Pro is a one-time purchase that adds unlimited trackers, reminders, Lock Screen widgets and a backup to your own Google Sheet. No account, no ads, no tracking.

records.name: CyberTwin
records.tagline: See how an attacker reaches your data, from your own configs
records.description: Upload your firewall, identity and cloud config files. CyberTwin shows the routes an attacker could take to the systems that matter and the one change that closes the most of them. Nothing is installed and nothing connects to your network. Try it on a FortiGate config in your browser.

records.name: Qrulla
records.tagline: Database client for Mac, Windows and Linux
records.description: MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Oracle, SQLite, MongoDB and Redis in one client. Copy tables and data between servers with copy and paste.

records.name: Greenhouse Builder Pro
records.tagline: Design a timber greenhouse in 3D, get the full cut list
records.description: Design a timber greenhouse in 3D and get everything to build it: setting-out drawings, a full cut list, an optimised timber buying list, glazing schedule, hardware count, costs and a printable build pack. Runs in your browser.

records.name: TutorsCRM
records.tagline: Simple CRM built for independent tutors.
records.description: TutorsCRM helps independent tutors manage students, lessons, calendars, invoices, income, expenses, homework, and daily tasks in one simple workspace. Spend less time organizing your tutoring business and more time teaching.

records.name: Learnvoro: Learn Anything
records.tagline: The course you wish existed. Now it does.
records.description: Learn anything, your way. Explore free courses across dozens of subjects. An AI tutor answers your questions, and a course curator helps you choose what to learn next.

records.name: T4xSuite
records.tagline: Native Android HTTP/HTTPS proxy, interceptor & repeater
records.description: T4xSuite is a native Kotlin toolkit for Android web traffic security testing. Inspect HTTP/HTTPS requests and responses, intercept and edit traffic inline, and replay raw HTTP(S) requests with an independent Repeater. Everything runs locally without root access.

records.name: A $2,500 Google Play Gift Card Could
records.tagline: A $2,500 Google Play Gift Card Could Be Yours
records.description: Enter for a chance to win a $2,500 Google Play gift card and explore digital entertainment on Google Play. Make sure you understand the official rules and deadline before entering. This is an independent promotion, not a Google-sponsored giveaway.

records.name: Ecoinch
records.tagline: Green building and ESG compliance in one connected workspace
records.description: Ecoinch connects green building and ESG certification requirements to tasks, evidence reviews, project tracking, CRM and procurement. Manage checklists, numerical scorecards, deadlines and documentation in one workspace. Built for sustainability professionals, with a free plan to get started.

records.name: Drop
records.tagline: A simultaneous interpreter in your pocket.
records.description: Drop translates voice and video calls live, along with voice messages and chats in 24 languages. On iPhone, Android and the web. No phone number or email needed.

records.name: Faceless Channel Pack
records.tagline: One niche in — a full 30-day faceless channel pack out
records.description: Faceless Channel Pack is an orchestrator that chains five existing modules into one faceless-channel workflow: Trend Scout finds topics, Story-to-Shorts writes the scripts, Talking-Head Kit renders them, ClipSmith plans captions/clips and Launch Autopilot sets the posting rhythm.

records.name: Alzyone
records.tagline: Position sizing, risk checks and a trade journal in one
records.description: Most traders don't blow up because of their strategy, but because of risk. Alzyone sizes every trade to your limit: enter entry, stop and target, get the exact size. Safety checks run before you enter, including whether your stop sits before liquidation. Import trades from 22 brokers and exchanges (Binance, Bybit, MT4/5, IBKR, TradingView and more) and see your profit and loss, win rate and a results calendar. It never places trades or touches funds. 7-day free trial, then $4.99/month.

records.name: etyma
records.tagline: A daily game about where words come from
records.description: A daily word puzzle about where English words come from. You get a modern word and its oldest known root, then place the forms in between: Old French, Latin, Proto-Indo-European. Harder puzzles branch into trees. Free in your browser, no login.

records.name: FUZMORI ECG Smart Ring
records.tagline: Record ECG, HRV and sleep. No subscription.
records.description: A smart ring that records a single-lead ECG, HRV, SpO2, resting heart rate and sleep. Export the raw trace or a PDF. $99 once, no subscription. 7–10 days per charge, IP68 + 5ATM, stainless steel.

records.name: Design to Scale
records.tagline: Learn system design through animated lessons
records.description: Learn Design to Scale through 40 animated system design lessons. Explore caching, databases and distributed systems. First 2 free; lifetime access $5.

records.name: Ayakashi Monogatari
records.tagline: A yokai strategy browser game where AI creates new yokai
records.description: Ayakashi Monogatari is a free strategy game you play in the browser, on phone or PC. Gather over 500 yokai from Japanese folklore, send them onto a shared map, and fight other players for land and shrines each season. Block roads, ward your shrines and lay traps with ploys. The heart of the game is Creation: cross two yokai, and AI creates a brand-new yokai, with its own art, name and legend, that belongs only to you. No install, no ads, English and Japanese.

records.name: Inclamo
records.tagline: AI agent that answers store calls and chats, acts on orders
records.description: Inclamo is one AI agent for your Shopify store's phone, web chat and email. It answers shoppers from your catalog, policies and order data, and takes the order actions you allow: refunds, free replacements, cancellations, address changes. Anything outside your rules goes to your team with the full conversation. A shopper can start in chat and call later without repeating the question. Free helpdesk; $0.49 per ticket, $0.29 per phone minute.

records.name: Zeia
records.tagline: A local-first connected memory for your meetings
records.description: Meeting summaries tell you what happened. Zeia helps you remember why. Capture and transcribe conversations or import from Teams and Zoom. Organise and search a local meeting library you own. Free Core works without AI. Optional AI connects your library, lets you find and ask across meetings and offers real-time answers. Connect Zeia to Claude Desktop. Search and gather your past meetings and ask across them. Claude follows your meetings live and turns meetings into work your team can share.

records.name: FreeModel Radar
records.tagline: Track which OpenRouter models are free — before they vanish
records.description: OpenRouter's free model list rotates without warning. FreeModel Radar watches it every 30 minutes and publishes a public status page with today's free models and the full change history — 3 changes last week alone. The free page is the whole tracker; Pro ($19/year) adds instant Telegram alerts the moment a model is added or removed, so your apps and agents never silently run out of free models.

records.name: Free Shopify Store Builder by Triad Mark
records.tagline: Free Shopify store builder we build and hand over your store
records.description: Triad Mark's free Shopify store builder is for people starting a new online store. Fill in one form, choose a free Shopify theme and add up to 10 products with photos and options such as size or color. Our team, an official Shopify Partner, builds the store and transfers full ownership to you, usually within 2 to 5 business days. The build is free. To accept the store, you choose a paid Shopify plan, which you pay to Shopify.

records.name: WA Multitools
records.tagline: 20 free WhatsApp tools in your browser. No sign-up.
records.description: WA Multitools is a free toolbox of 20 WhatsApp utilities that run entirely in your browser. Message anyone without saving their number, create wa.me links and QR codes with pre-filled text, style text in 150+ fonts, view profile pictures in full size, and try fun tools like Emoji Quiz and Truth or Dare. No app to install, no account, no data uploaded, your numbers and text never leave your device.

records.name: Forms™ Generator
records.tagline: Turn your Sheets™ questions into Forms™ quizzes in one click
records.description: Write your questions in a spreadsheet and Forms Generator builds the Google Form for you. Great for quizzes, surveys and long question banks. Works as an add-on inside Google Sheets. Free plan available. Links: Website: https://sheetstoforms.com/ Install: https://workspace.google.com/marketplace/app/appname/505223292051

records.name: TAHFUZ HERBALS
records.tagline: Modern Herbal Health. Formulated with Purpose.
records.description: **TAHFUZ™ HERBALS** is a modern herbal healthcare brand creating purpose-driven formulations with carefully selected botanical ingredients. Combining traditional herbal knowledge with a contemporary approach to formulation and quality, we develop products designed to support everyday health and wellness across multiple categories. Our focus is simple: thoughtful ingredients, purposeful formulations and quality at every step. **Modern Herbal Health. Formulated with Purpose.**

records.name: Huebloom
records.tagline: A secret place to color: free printable coloring PDFs
records.description: Huebloom is a free library of printable coloring-page PDFs for kids, families, classrooms, and homeschool. Every page is designed and refined by our illustrators, many with a little story or a bit of humor, and all were made in 2026. We add about 1,500 new pages every 30 days. Browse by theme or season, preview, and download a PDF to print at home.

records.name: Proactive AI Agent Blueprint
records.tagline: Turn passive chatbots into autonomous AI partners in 4 steps
records.description: Stop babysitting AI prompts and start managing autonomous digital partners. This zero-code playbook helps busy professionals pick and deploy the right proactive AI agent—Meta Muse, OpenAI Dots, or Claude Duet—to automate daily workflows. What's Inside: Deep-dive breakdown & pricing matrix of Muse, Dots, and Claude Duet Role-based decision flowchart to match your exact workflow Plug-and-play COO System Prompt & 8 AM briefing templates Human-in-the-Loop security checklist to protect your data

records.name: Meow Bento
records.tagline: Route ingredients through a conveyor puzzle for cats
records.description: Meow Bento is a conveyor-routing puzzle where you rotate the line and send rice, salmon, and broccoli into each cat's box in the right order. It includes 99 handcrafted levels, unlockable bento styles, 20 interface languages, and offline core play with no account. Levels 1–2 are untimed; later levels use a fixed 60-second timer. From level 4, an optional rewarded ad can continue one failed run.

records.name: AMRescue Data Recovery Advanced
records.tagline: Recover deleted, lost and formatted files on Windows
records.description: Windows data recovery software that recovers deleted, formatted and lost files from hard disks, SSDs, USB drives and memory cards, with lost partition recovery, disk imaging and BitLocker support.

records.name: RGMP
records.tagline: A free music player for Mac with a 20-band equalizer
records.description: RGMP is a free music player for macOS. Your files, your own Navidrome server, internet radio, YouTube and Yandex Music in one window. A 20-band equalizer that keeps a curve per output device, AudioUnit and VST3 effects over everything you play, crossfades and loudness normalization. Smart playlists, a library that watches your folders, plugins that install and update from inside the player. Five languages, Apple Silicon and Intel, no ads, no sign-up.

records.name: Flutter Starter Kit
records.tagline: Production Flutter boilerplate: Auth, Riverpod & Material 3
records.description: Save 40+ hours of setup with this production-ready Flutter 3.47+ boilerplate. Features plug-and-play Auth architecture (Supabase & Firebase drop-in ready), swipeable onboarding, centralized Material 3 theming, Riverpod 2.6 state management, and 35 automated unit/widget tests with 100% pass rate. Verified on physical Android hardware and Web. Includes full source code, release signing guide, and live web demo.

records.name: Curved Sliding Door -TC100 -TSTC
records.tagline: Curved Door |Circular Door -TC100 from TSTC Automatic Doors
records.description: TSTC automatic curved door also called circular sliding door. It possess the revolving doors' better air tightness, gorgeous appearance and sliding doors' concise design, easy operation and bigger pedestrian traffic volume /traffic flow warmly welcomed by lots of hotels, shopping malls, airports and other types of buildings all around the world. There are 3 types for our curved sliding door, Full Circular, Semi-Circular and Segmental Type.

records.name: Meetings & Calendar Skills for AI Agents
records.tagline: Better meetings, notes and calendar control
records.description: AI agent skills for meeting preparation, agenda creation, meeting notes, action tracking, follow-up emails, calendar audits, scheduling and decision documentation. - afeezadebayo/meetings-calendar-...

records.name: Wholesale Manager
records.tagline: One place for every supplier, order and box you sell
records.description: Wholesale Manager helps online sellers and agencies track suppliers, brand approvals, purchase orders, invoices and stock for every store in one place. No more spreadsheets. Start with a demo store and see it in minutes.

records.name: MemoryWorks
records.tagline: Company memory for people and AI agents
records.description: MemoryWorks is the memory layer for engineering organizations. It captures decisions, context and know-how from your team's sources and makes it available to people and AI agents, always tied back to where it came from. Works with ChatGPT and Claude Code via an MCP server. Open source (AGPL-3.0).

records.name: researchmanagr
records.tagline: Project management for busy academics
records.description: researchmanagr is project management for academic researchers. Upload a grant award PDF and it becomes a living project brief: dates, milestones, reporting deadlines and contacts. Each morning, a short list shows the 3-5 things that actually matter, each with a one-line reason and the smallest next step. Built for academics running several funded projects at once, after the grant is awarded. 2-week free trial, then $19 CAD/month or $149 CAD/year, often reimbursable through university funds.

records.name: Sara AI
records.tagline: Work with your financial files. Keep your context.
records.description: Your financial files, conversations, and AI models, all in one workspace. Upload spreadsheets, PDFs, XMLs, and financial documents. Ask questions, analyze your numbers, and turn information into reports. Switch between OpenAI and Anthropic models without losing your context or starting from scratch :)

records.name: Sensory Budget
records.tagline: Spoon theory for iPhone: see what will drain you today
records.description: A spoon theory energy forecast app for ADHD, autistic and sensory-sensitive people. It reads your calendar and sleep and shows what today will cost you, event by event. Rate how an event felt and it learns what similar ones will cost. Insights connect things you'd never put together, like your sleep and heart rate from Apple Health. Mine showed me I usually sleep badly the night before an interview. It also catches your heart rate running higher before a certain meeting.

records.name: Mechanical Keyboard App－FunKey
records.tagline: Typing Sound, Key Press audio
records.description: Transform your iPhone typing experience with FunKey, a custom keyboard extension that brings realistic mechanical keyboard sounds wherever you type. Whether you're sending messages, writing emails, taking notes, or posting on social media, every key press feels more satisfying. Choose Your Favorite Keyboard Sound. Explore over 25 premium sound profiles inspired by real mechanical keyboards: Features: FunKey works entirely on your device.

records.name: Tattle
records.tagline: firewall that shows which apps connect where
records.description: A menu bar network monitor and firewall for people who want to see and decide what their Mac’s apps reach. It starts by watching: every connection is listed under its app, with a sentence on why it was allowed or blocked. Ask mode asks about connections no rule covers; Lockdown blocks whatever has no rule. Rules name apps by code signature, domains, addresses, ports and directions. Optional encrypted DNS sends lookups to a resolver you choose.

records.name: Resource Cracker
records.tagline: Resource viewer & editor for binary files EXE/DLL/RES/MUI/RC
records.description: Resource Cracker is a free Windows program for viewing and editing resources in executables (EXE/DLL/MUI/DRV/EFI) and in standalone resource files (RES/RC). Built-in visual editors for dialogs, string tables, menus, bitmaps, icons and other resource types. RC/RES scripting supported, CLI automation, scripting. Open a file, pick a resource, and inspect it as a preview, a structured editor, or raw bytes. Supports PE32, PE64+, 16bit NE,NET, MUI resources. Available in 15+ languages.

records.name: camada
records.tagline: An AI analyst that keeps attackers out of your app
records.description: See who is attacking your app, then keep them out. Add one middleware. camada's AI analyst reviews your traffic every few minutes and finds credential stuffing, scrapers and exploit scans. Each attacker gets a written verdict, with a confidence and the requests behind it. Blocking is a lookup in your app's memory, so the AI is never on the request path. Customers and Googlebot get in. The free plan shows every verdict. MIT licensed SDKs for Node, Python, Go, PHP, Ruby, Java and C# (.NET).

records.name: NexoLumi CRM
records.tagline: Simple CRM and Kanban pipeline for small sales teams
records.description: I built NexoLumi CRM for small sales teams losing follow ups across chats and spreadsheets. It keeps contacts, a visual Kanban deal board, agenda, financial tracking and commercial reports in one clean workspace. Our public site is in Portuguese while the workspace supports both English and Portuguese. WhatsApp Cloud and assistive AI flows remain in beta while we finish our Google Play closed test, so I would appreciate honest feedback on the core CRM experience.

records.name: CleanMate
records.tagline: Open-source Mac & Ubuntu cleaner your AI agent can run
records.description: CleanMate frees disk space on macOS and Ubuntu: system caches and logs, developer junk (Xcode, Docker, Homebrew, node_modules), downloaded AI models, apps with their leftovers. Everything is previewed first and removed only after you confirm. A `cleanmate` command and an Agent Skill let Claude Code or Codex scan first and clean only what you approve. Free, MIT, no account, no telemetry.

records.name: Handball Hub
records.tagline: Handball live scores, fantasy, & highlights
records.description: Handball Hub is the all-in-one home for handball fans, on the web, iOS and Android. Follow live scores with momentum charts, shot maps and AI match recaps; check fixtures, standings and player stats; read the latest news; and play fantasy handball in private leagues across 12 competitions, including the EHF Champions League. Covers 80 men's and women's competitions in 9 languages. Free to use.

records.name: Board64
records.tagline: One board for your chess training, classes and tournaments
records.description: Board64 keeps a chess player's work together. Look up a position in over a million master games, keep the lines you like in a study, drill them from memory, then import your own games and see the move where you left your repertoire. Coaches teach live on a shared board with video, and every class can be watched again. Organizers run pairings, results and standings, and show every game live from electronic boards or the players' own scoresheets. Free for players and organizations.

records.name: Youse
records.tagline: A private space for couples to grow closer, every day.
records.description: Youse is a private digital space for couples to feel closer, build meaningful habits, and create lasting memories. Answer daily questions, share moods, save special moments, make plans, and build relationship rituals together. Whether you're living together or miles apart, Youse makes staying connected a little easier, every day. Just you, your partner, and a brighter us.

records.name: Riggr
records.tagline: Visual workspace for AI-powered development
records.description: Riggr brings your development workflow into one visual workspace, connecting your tools with AI agents running locally. Use an interactive Canvas to manage your terminal, code editor, databases, Docker, Git, HTTP requests, and browser. Less switching between tools. More focus on building.

records.name: Blink
records.tagline: Describe any trade and watch Blink build it
records.description: "If they announce Jensen is back, long NVDA and short AMD." The news that moves a stock usually lands while you're asleep or in a meeting, and by the time you see it the move is over. Blink is a trading app where you describe any trade in plain English and it builds it, then watches around the clock. It can trigger on a post on X, a headline, an earnings result, a line said on a live earnings call or a shift in prediction market odds, and it places the trade the moment it happens.

records.name: Thin Air
records.tagline: Climb Mount Everest on real terrain, in your browser
records.description: Climb Everest from Base Camp to the summit by the South Col route, on real satellite terrain. The air and your blood oxygen follow real physics, so every metre gets harder. One climb takes about 12 minutes. Free and open source, nothing to install.

records.name: Parallax
records.tagline: Find a cofounder whose skills complement yours
records.description: Parallax is a cofounder-matching app for high school and college students. You build a founder profile with your skills, education, idea, availability and the kind of cofounder you need. Parallax ranks other student founders with a seven-factor score and explains each match. Role fit uses a harmonic mean, so a pair where each founder covers the other's gaps beats a one-sided match. Swipe right on each other to match and chat. Free on iOS and the web.

records.name: QuillJet
records.tagline: Webflow forms and orders into your email tool.
records.description: QuillJet adds or updates a contact in Mailchimp, Klaviyo, Brevo, MailerLite, ActiveCampaign, Omnisend or GetResponse when a Webflow form is submitted, an order is placed or a CMS item changes. Each rule maps fields, sets conditions and decides whether a new contact is subscribed. Contacts are matched by email, so nobody is added twice, and every delivery is in an event log. QuillJet does not send email. There's a free plan, and paid plans start at $19 a month with no per-task charge.

records.name: GroupChatRobot
records.tagline: A group chat where everyone asks the same AI
records.description: Start a room, send the link, and friends join with a Google sign-in. No app to install. Everyone asks the same robot, and the whole room sees the answer. It reads the PDFs, photos, Word and Excel files shared in the room and names the file it used. Ask privately and only you see the reply. Free during beta.

records.name: Timenox 360
records.tagline: Field workforce management, from attendance to execution
records.description: Timenox 360 connects field attendance, site visits, tasks and operational visibility in one workspace. Built for distributed teams in sales, service, logistics and multi-location operations, it gives employees a mobile app to manage their working day and managers a web portal to coordinate activity across locations. GPS location updates are tied to the active work session, from check-in to check-out. Start with a 14-day free trial.

records.name: sb0s Galaxy
records.tagline: The AI-native operating system
records.description: Galaxy is a new operating system built around Edith, an AI agent that acts on your word. Speak or type, and your computer does the rest. A new kernel, built from zero. Runs your Linux apps natively. Free ISO with local AI on modern laptops; optional cloud AI at $10/month for older machines. First release for PCs and x86 laptops. Flash it live from your browser - no install needed.

records.name: Mamori
records.tagline: Block adult sites on your phone, locked on a calm day
records.description: Mamori blocks 2.5M+ adult sites across your whole phone, including Japanese sites many filters miss. On a calm day you pick the lock: a wait, a phrase, or a partner PIN a friend keeps. When protection is off, everything is off.

records.name: Amazing Karaoke Maker
records.tagline: #1 Inbuilt Offline Ai Vocal Remover and Ad Free
records.description: 🎤 AMAZING KARAOKE MAKER (Ad Free) Create stunning Full HD karaoke videos directly on your Android phone! Amazing Karaoke Maker is a powerful, ad-free karaoke video creator featuring AI Vocal Remover, real-time lyrics synchronization, ultra-fast video rendering, professional audio tools, and beautiful neon effects. Why wait forever to create a karaoke video? Our optimized rendering engine delivers incredibly fast MP4 exports.

records.name: Sova
records.tagline: Tasks, rituals and goals. One happy owl.
records.description: Sova puts your to-dos, daily habits and big goals on one calm iPhone screen. Type "Call Mom tomorrow 6pm !!" and it fills in the day, time and priority. Rituals keep streaks on the days you choose, goals break into steps, and an owl companion celebrates when you finish your day. Built natively in SwiftUI for iOS 26 and Liquid Glass, with widgets, Siri and an Apple Watch app. No data collected.

records.name: The AI Operator's Tax Prep Organizer
records.tagline: A 12-page printable that organizes your freelance taxes
records.description: Tax season is a paperwork hunt for freelancers: 1099s from half a dozen clients, receipts in three apps, a mileage log that doesn't exist. This 12-page printable gives you one fill-in-the-blanks system — income and 1099 log, Schedule C categories, mileage log, quarterly payment tracker, home-office worksheet, document checklist, and a deductions review — plus 6 AI prompts that categorize expenses and draft CPA questions for you. Print it once in October and walk into January organized.

records.name: weedit Shipping Cost Estimator
records.tagline: Customers see shipping costs in the cart, before checkout
records.description: Customers pick their country, plus a region or postal code where needed, and see your store's shipping rates for their cart, with prices and delivery dates when Shopify provides them. Rates come from your shipping settings, carrier-calculated ones included, so there is nothing extra to maintain. Local delivery and pickup are not shown. Turn on the app embed for the cart page and cart drawer, or add the app block to a cart section. Set wording, button color and corner radius in the theme editor.

records.name: Maker Mockup Tool
records.tagline: Apply online your designs to products and packaging
records.description: With our powerful, easy-to-use online editor, you can transform ordinary designs into professional-quality product images directly in your browser. No complicated software, advanced technical skills, or design experience required. Simply upload your artwork, customize your scene, and generate beautiful, high-quality images in just a few clicks.

records.name: $2,500 Google Play Gift Card Giveaway
records.tagline: Your Guide to the $2,500 Google Play Gift Card Giveaway
records.description: Want to participate? Check the promotion page for the entry process, eligibility requirements, and closing date for this $2,500 Google Play gift card giveaway. No Google sponsorship or endorsement is implied.

records.name: Image Compressor by Aizen Labs
records.tagline: Shrink any photo to the exact KB you need — free
records.description: Set the exact KB you need — 50, 100, 200, any number — and this compressor lands at or just under it, every time. A binary-search engine lowers quality before touching dimensions, so you keep as much detail as the size allows. Batch compress a whole folder and download one ZIP, with a before/after slider to check quality. Free, no signup, no watermark, nothing uploaded — it runs entirely in your browser and strips EXIF/GPS data.

records.name: LabelSage
records.tagline: Scan food labels for your whole family's allergies
records.description: Not a score. Fits you or doesn't, and the reason why. LabelSage checks food ingredients against the allergies of everyone you shop for. Add each person once, then scan a barcode or search a product by name. You get one result per person (OK for, Check first, Not for, Can't confirm) plus the ingredient that decided it, including hidden names like whey and casein. No account, no ads, no tracking. Free on iPhone.

records.name: Bulk Domain Age Checker Tool
records.tagline: Bulk Domain Age Checker – Check Website Age Free | Gold Flex
records.description: Bulk Domain Age Checker by Gold Flex Marketing is a free tool to check the age of up to 100 domains at once. Paste your list and get each domain's exact age, registration date, expiry date and registrar in one table, using live RDAP data. No signup required, plus Excel export. Perfect for SEO professionals vetting expired domains, auditing backlinks, researching competitors and qualifying outreach targets. Save hours of manual WHOIS lookups. Try it today.

records.name: Ospitario
records.tagline: Vacation rentals, structured for AI and direct host contact
records.description: Ospitario helps vacation-rental hosts create structured property passports that guests and AI assistants can read. Guests can inspect property details, see which proofs were checked and when, and contact the host directly. Developers can connect via MCP and API. Built by a host for hosts. Registration is free during the pilot, with no booking commissions. Ospitario handles neither bookings nor payments; guests and hosts agree directly.

records.name: Digitals Cafe
records.tagline: Digital marketing services that turn clicks into customers.
records.description: Digitals Cafe is a digital marketing agency that turns clicks into customers. Founded in 2019. Services: SEO Services — technical and on-page SEO, local SEO. Lead Generation — campaigns. Social Media Marketing — content and growth. Paid Advertising — Google Ads and Meta Ads. Web Development — websites that convert. AI & Automation — tools that save time. Influencer Marketing — connecting brands with the right voices. Training — digital marketing training for individuals and teams.

records.name: Qaalia
records.tagline: AI agents that operate your business systems
records.description: Qaalia is a SaaS platform designed to build and host artificial intelligence agents capable of operating directly on a business's systems. Instead of just chatting, these agents reason, consult documents, and carry out real actions by connecting to existing APIs, databases, or MCP servers under strict permissions. It also makes it easy to integrate that intelligence into your own apps, websites, or bots through a single API and secure access keys.

records.name: Wonder Town
records.tagline: A 3D math adventure from grade 1 through middle school
records.description: Wonder Town is a browser-based 3D math adventure for grades 1 through middle school (ages 6–15). Kids pick a hero, explore 13 floating towns, and answer villagers' math questions to reach the gate in five minutes. Banks follow US, China, Japan, Singapore or India curricula, or parents can turn test photos into practice. Town 1 is free with no account; free accounts open the first three towns. Passport is $9.80/month for all 13 towns and custom banks. No ads, chat, or public profiles.

records.name: Eetspots
records.tagline: Find a last-minute table in the Netherlands
records.description: Eetspots covers around 10,000 restaurants in 44 Dutch cities through the Netherlands. You search by dish, cuisine, neighbourhood or moment, and see which restaurants serve it and what it costs on the menu. It shows where a table is still free, across the booking systems restaurants already use. Eetspots has read more than 2,500 menus and compares prices per dish, so you can see what a dish usually costs in each city. Eetspots is free for both users and restaurants, using a freemium model.

records.name: Daily Charm: Habit & Todo List
records.tagline: Lock Screen Calendar & Widgets
records.description: Hey Product Hunt! 👋 I'm the creator of Daily Charm. I wanted to build a productivity app that feels rewarding rather than overwhelming. With Daily Charm, you can: 🌱 Build healthy daily habits ✅ Complete tasks directly from your Lock Screen 🌦️ Plan your day with weather insights ✨ Discover and collect adorable Charms 🤝 Build habits together with friends My goal is to make everyday productivity feel a little more personal, playful, and enjoyable. Thank you for checking out Daily Charm! ❤️

records.name: DMaple
records.tagline: DMaple x Bridge: More Ways to Move Money Globally
records.description: We're partnering with Bridge to expand the payment options available through DMaple. By bringing together Bridge's stablecoin infrastructure and DMaple's payment workflows, we're working to make it easier for businesses to move between digital assets and local currencies. More payment routes. More flexibility. One workflow for global payouts. What payment markets would you like to see supported next? #DMaple #Bridge #ProductUpdate #GlobalPayments

records.name: Mouse Aide
records.tagline: Reverse mouse scroll, remap buttons, add Finder menu items
records.description: • Reverse the mouse wheel, keep the trackpad natural • A direction and speed for each mouse and trackpad • Mouse buttons: keyboard shortcuts, play/pause, desktops, with per-app settings • Middle-click on a trackpad: three-finger tap or Fn-click • ⌘ + right-click in any Finder window or on the Desktop: new documents, Copy Path, Open In • The same in Finder's right-click menu, in your Home folder, once turned on (macOS 14, or 15.2 and later) • Entirely offline, collects nothing macOS 14 or later

records.name: RankGEO
records.tagline: See if ChatGPT can find — and cite — your website
records.description: RankGEO checks whether your website is visible to AI answer engines — ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Claude — and gives you a 0-100 GEO score with fixes. Paste any URL: AI crawler access (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended), Meta & headings — are they AI-readable?, JSON-LD check, and a 0-100 citation visibility score. The free audit needs no account and shows score and findings. The full Fix Kit (JSON-LD, robots.txt rules, prioritised fix list) is a one-time $49 (excl. tax).

records.name: NovaNetFlow
records.tagline: Build and host a beautiful WordPress site in a minute
records.description: NovaNetFlow gives you a fully hosted WordPress site with a drag-and-drop builder that's actually fun to use. Pick a name, choose a ready-made design for a restaurant, podcast, band, photographer or business, and go live in under a minute. Add animations, parallax and wave dividers, preview on a phone, then publish. Hosting, SSL, security, backups and updates are handled for you. Plans from $4/month with a 7-day free trial.

records.name: whats360.live
records.tagline: WhatsApp CRM, AI bots & campaigns for Arabic-first teams
records.description: whats360.live turns a regular WhatsApp number into a team workspace: shared inbox with staff permissions, scheduled bulk campaigns, AI auto-replies, and a built-in CRM with tags, notes and history. Documented REST API and webhooks, with Shopify, WooCommerce and n8n guides on our developer hub (github.com/whats360-api). Separate Email, SMS and VCash tools share the dashboard, each with its own plan. QR-based, like WhatsApp Web. Not the official WhatsApp Business API; not affiliated with Meta.

records.name: Permits at Dawn
records.tagline: Scored permit leads in your inbox by 5:30 AM
records.description: Permits at Dawn reads the new building permits Dallas, Fort Worth, Austin, and Chicago publish, scores them from 0 to 100, and sorts them for your trades. Each weekday by 5:30 AM Central, the permits that fit your counties land in your inbox with the Top 10 in call order. Each lead carries the address, the work type in plain words, and the names the record publishes. Homeowner phone numbers and emails stay out. Plans run $49 to $149 a month, and the free sample needs no credit card.

records.name: RO Lite - Match: Tile Puzzle
records.tagline: Enjoy tile-matching puzzles with Ragnarok monsters!
records.description: One, two, three! Match three identical tiles for a satisfying burst of fun! Discover hidden surprises in the colorful and cozy puzzle world of Ragnarok! RO Lite - Match is a casual, level-based puzzle game where you collect three matching tiles to clear them from the board. Tap tiles featuring familiar Ragnarok monsters, items, and other charming designs. Match three identical tiles and clear them all to complete each level! But finding matching tiles is only the beginning.

records.name: MacSweep
records.tagline: Clean up Mac storage with safe, reviewed recommendations
records.description: MacSweep is an open-source macOS cleanup utility that helps you find reclaimable storage across caches, logs, large files, duplicate files, unused apps, and developer artifacts. It separates safe recommendations from items that need review, so nothing is removed without your approval. You can scan storage, inspect associated app files before uninstalling, review privacy data, track storage health, and move supported files to Trash when appropriate.

records.name: Industrial Op Atlas
records.tagline: Find industrial projects before they hit the bid boards
records.description: Early industrial project leads from permits and filings in all 50 states, ranked daily for what you sell, mapped in 3D and researched by AI, with a built-in CRM. Free plan and 14-day trial.

records.name: VibeCode.surf
records.tagline: AI code editor where agents build, run and test your app
records.description: VibeCode.surf is an AI code editor for your desktop. Several agents plan, write, run and test your code on your own computer, with any model. Say what you want, and a lead agent splits the job across helpers that write the code, run it and test it in a real browser. It runs on your computer with any model, from Claude and GPT to a local one, and shows what every reply costs.

records.name: Gujju Garba
records.tagline: Gujju Garba
records.description: 🏆 Gujju Garba Competition — Show Your Talent, Get Recognized! Think you've got the best Garba moves? Now's your chance to prove it! Gujju Garba is the #1 platform for Garba lovers to compete, get recognized, and shine — all from your phone. No stage. No crowd. Just your Garba, your style, your reel. Track your position in real-time on the live leaderboard. See where you stand against other participants and push harder to reach the top. Anyone who loves Garba!

records.name: ImagineMōde
records.tagline: Design your modular furniture first. Build it once.
records.description: Get your layout right before you build. Design your Herman Miller Story bookcase, share it with friends or the community, find inspiration, and build with a free step-by-step guide. More furniture coming soon. Not affiliated with Herman Miller.

records.name: DreamLook - AI Hairs & Beauty
records.tagline: Haircut, Color & Face Shape AI
records.description: See your new look before you change a thing. DreamLook is an AI hair and beauty studio that lets you try on hairstyles, haircuts and colors on your own photo in seconds - so you can walk into the salon knowing exactly what suits you. WHAT HAIRCUT SUITS YOUR FACE? Upload a selfie and let DreamLook analyze your face shape and personal colors. Get a realistic AI hairstyle try on, compare looks side by side, and pick the cut and color that fits you - no guessing, no regrets.

records.name: Tray
records.tagline: macOS file manager in a screen corner
records.description: A file manager for macOS that lives in a screen corner. Drop files on the shelf, preview them, group them into a folder, drag them anywhere, or send them to the Bin — without opening Finder.

records.name: Sen Việt (VieLotus-IM)
records.tagline: Smart Bilingual input method for macOS, Windows, and Linux.
records.description: Vietnamese input method. This repository contains the macOS Swift engine and InputMethodKit app, the C++20 Windows and Linux engines and adapters, and a freestanding WebAssembly SDK.

records.name: Qube
records.tagline: An AI agent for anyone
records.description: Qube is a personal AI assistant that works on your behalf, not just answers. It plans, uses tools, checks its own output, and comes back with the job done — real files, cited research, forms filled, apps updated. It's proactive: set a goal or a schedule and it runs the task to the end, asking only when a decision or risky action needs you. Your files stay on your machine. Free and open-source. Bring your own model — cloud or local — the assistant and its autonomy are the product.

records.name: AppGapRadar
records.tagline: Public reports of real problems, plus one small app idea
records.description: AppGapRadar is a free feed for anyone deciding what to build next. Every brief starts with a problem someone reported in public, then adds one small app idea and an honest reason it might not be worth building. You get the original source, a plain account of the problem, a first version small enough to test, and questions to ask before you commit. Search, filter by category, and save ideas in your browser. No account. One report is a clue, not proof anyone will pay.

records.name: Timewize
records.tagline: Run resources, projects & finances in one platform
records.description: Timewize is a PSA platform for agencies, IT services, accounting and consulting firms. Plan resources, run projects, track time, bill clients and see project margin in one place. Built-in AI: an assistant that answers questions on your data, a time-draft assistant that pre-fills timesheets, a project agent that helps set up projects, and burn and predictive agents that flag budget overrun and margin risk early.

records.name: Tabner
records.tagline: A free tab manager with boards, sessions and spaces
records.description: Too many tabs open? Tabner is a free tab manager for Chrome, Edge and Firefox that saves your tabs and whole windows into visual boards you can search. Keep Work and Personal apart with spaces, and find any saved tab with Ctrl+K or by typing tb in the address bar. On Chrome, you choose whether Tabner opens on every new tab. No account needed: without one, your data stays in your browser and never reaches our servers. Imports from OneTab and Toby. 9 languages.

records.name: Niori
records.tagline: Interactive AI presentations for you, your team and agents
records.description: Niori sits between template-driven presentation tools and general AI chat and coding apps, where presentations are a side job. Turn a thought, doc or link into a custom, interactive presentation with clickable charts, diagrams, equations and calculators. Keep improving it over time: in chat, right on the slide, or by tagging @niori in a comment. Work on it live with your team, and let your own agents, like Claude or Codex, edit it through MCP. Free to start.

records.name: HADS
records.tagline: Multiply your traffic by trading readers with other sites
records.description: Search and AI answers now keep most of the clicks, so independent sites stop getting new readers. HADS multiplies the traffic you already have: show one text ad for another member's site, and the network shows yours to their readers, one for one. Your own traffic stays yours, the network adds a second stream on top, and it compounds: the readers it brings earn you more reach. For any site with its own content, plus CLIs and AI agents. Free.

records.name: Niro
records.tagline: Hermes, DeepSeek Harness, Qwen, Kimi & more on your iPhone
records.description: Search across projects and AI agent conversations. Continue your Mac-based coding work from your iPhone. NIRO connects Hermes, DeepSeek Harness, OpenCode, Qwen Code, Kimi Code and MiMo in one local-first workspace. Use Universal Search to find indexed conversations, revisit project context with Project Memory, and pick up supported sessions through Niro Bridge. Features vary by agent.

records.name: CocoReader: Book to Audiobook
records.tagline: Listen to the books you already own
records.description: Listen to the books you already own. CocoReader turns your books and documents into audiobooks with 20+ natural voices on iPhone, iPad, Apple Silicon Mac, Apple Watch, and CarPlay. Import EPUB, PDF, plain text, photos, or a web article, pick a voice, and press play. This Black Friday, the first year is US$19.99 through December 1, 2026.

records.name: ETAOS
records.tagline: Your entire company. One operating system.
records.description: Companies don't have a software problem. They have a patchwork problem: 6 to 15 disconnected tools, data in silos, workflows stitched together by hand. ETAOS replaces the patchwork with one AI-native operating system configured around how your organization actually works - CRM, projects, finance, HR, analytics, learning, plus custom modules for anything else you run. One system, one memory. For the first time, you can talk to your business.

records.name: Everycent
records.tagline: A budget that fits your pay and changes your habits
records.description: Connect your bank and Everycent sorts your spending and sets a budget for each thing from what you usually spend, so it fits your pay. Then it helps you change the habits that cost you, one small change at a time: it spots the spending that repeats, like a takeaway every Sunday night, and helps you cut back. When a month gets tight, it tells you early and shows where the money can come from. Read-only bank access, no ads, never lends. Works with banks across Europe and the UK.

records.name: Virtual Public Stock Exchange
records.tagline: What is your software product worth?
records.description: VPSE estimates what it would cost to buy a software product outright: brand, rights, source code and every product in its family. Register with an email at your product's domain; an AI reads public signals (website, traffic, app stores, repositories) and weighs income, market and cost approaches. Products valued at $1M+ go on a public board. Works for desktop, mobile, web, SaaS and open-source libraries. Free for the first 100 users. Estimates are indicative, not financial advice.

records.name: ArabicWebFont
records.tagline: Arabic name calligraphy in 29 fonts, free PNG & SVG
records.description: ArabicWebFont converts Latin names into Arabic script and renders them across 29 open-licensed (SIL OFL 1.1) calligraphy fonts in 6 styles: Naskh, Kufi, Ruq'ah, Nastaliq, Decorative, and Modern. Everything runs locally in your browser with no signup, no watermark, and no daily limit. Export transparent PNGs or vector SVGs, and check verified 7-language character coverage (including Jawi and Pegon) plus measured safe harakat line-heights for each font.

records.name: Wall Street Virtual City
records.tagline: Explore the real stock market in an open-world 3D game
records.description: What if the stock market was an open-world video game? Wall Street Virtual City is a free, browser-based 3D experience where real publicly traded companies become skyscrapers shaped by market capitalization. Explore an immersive financial metropolis, discover companies, access stock prices and financial news, earn virtual coins, and experience investing like never before. No downloads required.

records.name: PDF Ninjas
records.tagline: 14 free PDF tools — no signup, no limits, no watermark
records.description: PDF Ninjas is a free online PDF toolkit — no signup, no watermark, no paywalls. Upload a file, get a result, move on. That's it. 14 tools: Merge · Split · Compress · Rotate · PDF to Word · PDF to JPG · PDF to Excel · Watermark · Page Numbers · Protect · Unlock · and more Privacy first: Files are processed in memory and deleted the moment your download is ready. No human ever sees your documents. Try it free → pdfninjas.com

records.name: LiveGrid
records.tagline: Screen share with friends: every screen at once, with sound
records.description: LiveGrid is a group call app where everyone can share their screen at the same time, side by side, each screen with its own volume slider and its own sound. Open a room, send the link, and friends join from the browser, even on a phone. Nothing to install. Voice, chat and watching screens are free. Pro is US$ 4.99/mo with a 7-day free trial: unlimited sharing at source quality, up to 60 fps. Desktop app for Windows and Mac too.

records.name: Biomarker Tracker
records.tagline: Track years of blood tests and see your biological age
records.description: Biomarker Tracker is a free, open-source app that keeps years of lab results and body measurements in one chart. It works out your biological age (PhenoAge), heart age and fitness age, explains every marker in plain words with sources, and tells a real change from normal variation. It reads lab PDFs and imports Apple Health, Garmin, Oura and more. Everything stays on your computer: no account, no cloud, no tracking. Windows, macOS and Linux, or try it in your browser.

records.name: RedBubblegum
records.tagline: Find buyers in communities asking for what you sell
records.description: Most lead-finding tools only match keywords, so they miss people who describe their problem in their own words. RedBubblegum scans every post in the communities it watches and finds the people actually asking for what you sell, however they phrase it. Paste your website or app link and see them every day or every hour, sorted hot, warm and cold so you know who to reach first. Built for founders, indie makers and small teams. Free to start, no card needed.

records.name: Overhang
records.tagline: County map of bank CRE concentration in the Northeast
records.description: Overhang reads the FDIC call reports of banks under $100B in assets and flags the ones at or near the 2006 interagency CRE concentration thresholds. It allocates each bank to the counties where it takes deposits and grades 180 of 218 Northeast counties from A to E. The quarterly report, the map and the county grades are free. Desk ($149/month) adds ratios per bank, the full ranking, history since 2015 and CSV export.

records.name: Visitmark
records.tagline: Smarter field operations with AI-powered reporting
records.description: Visitmark is an AI-powered field service management platform built for supervisors and technicians. Manage sites, track equipment, document technical visits, capture photo evidence, complete digital checklists, and generate professional reports. Available in English and Spanish, Visitmark helps teams reduce paperwork, improve productivity, and stay in control of their field operations.

records.name: AlqEdge Skills
records.tagline: Battle-tested SKILL.md packs for solo founders
records.description: Sell-ready SKILL.md packs built from real one-person-company work. Drop into Claude Code, OpenClaw/Hermes or Gemini CLI — 30s install, one-time price, lifetime updates. Virtual CFO: real 2026 SaaS benchmarks (Grid, SaaSrise, Benchmarkit) — runway, burn multiple, NDR, LTV:CAC. Virtual CMO: budget allocation + 2 Python calculators. Opportunity Validation: 8-field GO/NO-GO sheet with competitor density check. Skill GTM: package any methodology into a sellable skill.

records.name: Renskrift
records.tagline: Markdown as a finished page. Your file stays untouched.
records.description: A Markdown editor for iPhone, iPad and Mac that shows your notes as a finished page and never rewrites what you didn't edit. Maths, diagrams, tables and code are drawn as you write. See what an AI assistant or another app changed. No account, no tracking. Reading is free; one purchase unlocks writing.

records.name: LiveGrid Classic
records.tagline: Watch Twitch, YouTube and Kick lives in one grid
records.description: LiveGrid Classic puts several live streams on one screen: Twitch, YouTube, Kick and live TV links side by side, from 1 to 8 screens. Pick a category (GTA VI, CS, LoL, VALORANT, Dota 2...) and the grid fills with who is live right now, or paste any channel link. Swap, mute, reorder by dragging, open the Twitch chat, go cinema mode, share your grid. Free in the browser, up to 4 streams, no card. An optional Pro plan unlocks 8.

records.name: MediaKit App
records.tagline: Convert, compress & download videos/images 100% offline
records.description: Free, open-source desktop app for Windows and Linux built with Tauri 2, Rust, and FFmpeg. Compress large videos without ruining quality, convert video, audio, and image formats in bulk, and download online media locally with zero cloud uploads, no file limits, and no watermarks.

records.name: FolioGen
records.tagline: Turn your CV or business into a portfolio website
records.description: Your CV lists where you worked. FolioGen turns it into a website that shows the work. Upload a CV (or answer five questions if you have none) and AI writes and builds your portfolio: headline, summary, projects with their own case study pages, and a contact form. Pick from seven templates, set your colours and fonts, and publish on your own link. See who visited with cookie-free insights, and tailor your intro to a specific job ad. Free to start, no account needed to preview.

records.name: Pertin Equipe
records.tagline: Transparent monitoring for company computers
records.description: Pertin Equipe is a productivity dashboard for teams that use company computers. It gives managers a place to review computer use and puts disclosure to employees at the center of workplace monitoring. Built by KTech AI in Brazil.

records.name: Contha
records.tagline: Untangle your business and personal money
records.description: Contha is for small business owners and freelancers whose business and personal money are mixed together. Connect your accounts and it sorts every transaction into business or personal, keeps a running Schedule C, and estimates what to set aside for quarterly taxes. Then it helps you plan: what you can pay yourself, which bills are coming, which card fits how you spend. Ask Claude or ChatGPT any of it. Try it free for a week.

records.name: urilinks
records.tagline: Save, organize, search, and share your favorite links.
records.description: Hi, I have created a website called urilinks.com where people can save, organize, search, and share their favorite website links. I would appreciate having someone try my website and share their suggestions. It is free to get started. https://urilinks.com Thank you for your time.

records.name: SparkVFX Studio Pro
records.tagline: Procedural 2D pixel VFX, animations & 8-bit audio suite
records.description: SparkVFX Studio Pro is an all-in-one procedural 2D visual effects generator, pixel art drawing canvas, and 8-bit audio synthesizer for indie game developers. Create explosions, magic blasts, sword slashes, and combat particles with customizable physics, force fields, and color palettes. Draw sprites with bilateral symmetry, juice animations with squash & stretch, and export game-ready transparent spritesheets, looping GIFs, audio WAVs, and animation metadata. Windows, Linux & Web.

records.name: Evernth Docs
records.tagline: Private PDF tools — most never leave your browser
records.description: 53 PDF tools: merge, split, compress, rotate, watermark, sign, page numbers, compare and more. Most run right in your browser, so your file never leaves your device. Tools that need a server delete your upload when the job ends and the result within an hour. Also: AI summaries, chat with PDF, table extraction, and compress presets for email, resume, passport, visa and exam forms. Free: 20 tasks/day (50 signed in). Pro is ₹199 or $4 a month.

records.name: 7 Deadly Sins Test
records.tagline: Which deadly sin rules you? Score all 7 in 3 minutes
records.description: A free personality quiz that scores you on all seven deadly sins — Pride, Greed, Lust, Envy, Gluttony, Wrath and Sloth. Rate 21 everyday statements, get a 0–100 score for each sin on a radar chart, and read your result as a mock classified case file. Share your result card, or compare scores with a friend. Plays in the browser — no sign-up, no download.

records.name: Charmotion
records.tagline: Turn your logo or mascot into interactive animations
records.description: Charmotion animates your own logo or character without redrawing it. Upload a PNG, JPEG, WebP or SVG (or design one with AI in the app) and get interactive Rive animations for your website and app, plus transparent WebM/MOV and MP4 video for everything else. Characters get a launch intro, idle, happy, wave and loading, and you can add more moods later. Every animation is planned, tuned and checked for your character before you see it.

records.name: KivoHelp
records.tagline: Affordable AI Customer Support for Small Businesses
records.description: KivoHelp is an AI customer support chatbot using business website content, documents, and FAQs. Free includes 1 public website embed, 25 monthly AI replies, and 3 knowledge sources; Starter, Growth, and Premium expand replies, sources, teammates, and monthly support-ticket allowances on Growth and Premium.

records.name: Glutely
records.tagline: Glute workouts, video imports and progress in one app
records.description: Turn workout inspiration into a routine you can follow. Glutely helps you organise glute-focused sessions, watch exercise demonstrations, save workouts from supported TikTok and Instagram links, and log training and meals. Use it in your browser or add it to your Home Screen as a PWA. Membership options are available in the app.

records.name: Hoanalu
records.tagline: AI surf forecasts, spot by spot
records.description: Surf forecasts are full of numbers, but the real question is simple: is it worth the trip? Hoanalu reads swell, wind and tide, then judges them in the context of each spot, because the same swell works very differently from one beach to the next. You get a session rating and a plain-language comment per time slot. Built for surfers from intermediate, autonomous level and up. Free to start, Pro unlocks every spot and the 7-day outlook. On iOS and Android.

records.name: Free-Utils
records.tagline: Free PDF, image, and video tools in your browser
records.description: Hit 100-500 KB upload limits without installing anything. Compress PDFs, turn phone photos into one PDF, merge, split and edit PDFs, convert iPhone HEIC to JPG, and shrink or convert video and audio. Files are processed on your device. Free, no watermark, no sign-up.

records.name: GPTA - Get paid to train AI
records.tagline: All AI training jobs in one place
records.description: Connect our free MCP server to Claude, ChatGPT or any agent and say "Find me remote AI training jobs paying $150+/hr." It searches an up-to-date directory of open data labeling and AI training jobs from 20+ companies, including Mercor, Alignerr and OpenTrain.

records.name: BBBus
records.tagline: Affordable Bus Tickets & Charter Rentals Across the U.S.
records.description: BBBUS makes booking intercity bus travel across the United States simple and affordable. Compare bus schedules and fares, discover routes, and book tickets online with ease. BBBUS serves travelers across New York, Albany, Philadelphia, Baltimore, and other destinations. Beyond ticket booking, BBBUS also provides charter bus services for group trips, corporate events, schools, and private travel. Enjoy convenient online booking, transparent pricing, and a more flexible way to travel.

records.name: Automata
records.tagline: Voice-first personal AI companion (Windows)
records.description: A voice-first, autonomous Windows desktop assistant with full OS control, multi-model AI reasoning, and enterprise-grade safety.
