Features: 📌 Voice by default, chat as an option. 📌 Multi-provider setup 📌 Memory 📌 Personalization of behaviour 📌 Real OS commands execution from speech 📌 Autonomous email summarizations, browsing, etc. 📌 Free tier and optional provider setup and API keys. 📌 Career goals assistance 📌 Multi-model reasoning 📌 Works in the background

records.name: The Concept Library
records.tagline: Concepts that make you thinking sharper
records.description: A free reference that explains the ideas behind good software in plain language. Every definition is checked against its sources and reviewed by a person before it goes live, then paired with an illustrated cover.

records.name: Quiesta
records.tagline: A whole-class review game for any big screen
records.description: Quiesta turns any worksheet, quiz, or review you already have into a board game the whole class plays on one big screen. Students work on paper, right answers earn spins, and anyone can win. Free in the browser, no account needed.

records.name: Deutli
records.tagline: Deutli is the German Language Learning Platform
records.description: Deutli is the German language from A1 level to B2 level learning platform: AI-checked homework confirmed by real teachers, timed mock exams, a readiness score and daily words, explained in English and multiple languages.

records.name: CorporateLeaks
records.tagline: Anonymous company reviews by real employees in India
records.description: Before you join a company, read what real employees say. CorporateLeaks lets people share honest reviews, salaries and office photos — fully anonymous. No login, no email, no name. We never store IP addresses.

records.name: Crushique
records.tagline: Flip through racks of secondhand tees—no search, no sorting
records.description: Crushique is a thrift-store rack, online. Pick a rack (a decade, a brand, a genre like band tees or biker tees) and flip through it one shirt at a time with the arrow keys. Each pass is finite, a few dozen shirts, and you pull out the ones you like. About 2,300 secondhand T-shirts from partner shops, T-shirts only. No account needed to flip. Built for desktop.

records.name: SuperCrypto
records.tagline: Free crypto portfolio and planning tools
records.description: Track holdings and explore crypto scenarios with a free portfolio dashboard, trading journal and planning calculators. Model fees, position sizes, DCA and rebalancing, save records on your device, and back them up. No account required. SuperCrypto does not execute trades or hold assets.

records.name: Curtains
records.tagline: Hide your Mac screen while Claude and Codex keep working
records.description: Step away from your Mac while Claude and Codex keep working. Curtains covers every connected display and keeps your Mac awake. Little pets show which agents are busy. Send tasks from your phone through your usual remote connection, then enter your curtain password when you get back.

records.name: Brandfig
records.tagline: Brand work, automated. Right inside Figma.
records.description: Brandfig automates brand work in Figma, so you create faster and ship sooner. Add your logo, colours and fonts, pick a style, and get a deck to present, guidelines to hand over and every file your client needs. Try it free for 3 days.

records.name: Wilt
records.tagline: A focus tree that wilts when you open YouTube
records.description: Wilt plants a tree in the corner of your screen while you work. Open YouTube, Reddit or X in your browser (or a distracting app) and it starts to wilt, right in front of you. Get back within 10 seconds and it pulls through. Every session ends up in a garden on your desktop: trees if you stayed, stumps if you didn't. Ten trees and a Monstera, no two alike. Mac and Windows. First 3 sessions free, then $9.99 once: no account, no subscription.

records.name: Kiritsu Trading Journal
records.tagline: Discipline-first trading journal for day traders
records.description: Kiritsu is a trading journal and discipline layer for futures day traders on Windows. - Pin your rules, plan and setups in windows that stay over your charts - A cooldown after a loss, and a stop window when a rule breaks - Live trade sync with NinjaTrader 8, Quantower, ATAS, Sierra Chart and MT5, plus CSV folder import - Stats, cost of broken rules, exit and emotion analysis - Local-first: your journal stays on your PC. No AI. Never places, changes or closes an order.

records.name: TechLoaded.net
records.tagline: 13 free image, PDF & AI tools — no sign-up needed
records.description: TechLoaded is 13 free online tools in one place — no sign-up, no upload, your files never leave your browser. AI Metadata Generator — upload stock photos, get a title, description and 49 keywords, export as CSV for Adobe Stock and Shutterstock. Image Converter, Resizer, Upscaler and Compressor — JPG, PNG, WebP and AVIF. Word to PDF, PDF to Word, Split PDF, PDF to JPG and Images to PDF. Image to Text (OCR) — photo of a receipt or whiteboard to editable text. QR Code Generator and Word Counter.

records.name: Twitch Points Auto Collector
records.tagline: Auto-claim Twitch Channel Points while you watch
records.description: Automatically claim Twitch Channel Points bonuses while you watch. See how many bonuses you’ve claimed per channel in the extension popup, and check your total claim count on the toolbar badge. Stats are stored locally. Install the open-source Chrome extension and open a Twitch stream to get started.

records.name: Wakebird
records.tagline: The alarm clock that checks traffic before it wakes you
records.description: An alarm clock that looks at traffic on your commute and moves your alarm. Empty roads? You get up to 30 extra minutes of sleep. Crash on the highway? It wakes you earlier so you're still on time. If it can't get traffic data, it just rings at the time you set. Works for driving, transit, walking, biking and taxis. No account needed.

records.name: PetAndMe
records.tagline: The two of you. In one frame
records.description: Create an AI portrait of you and your pet from everyday photos. Pick a template or describe your own scene, then add separate reference photos of yourself and your pet. Turn a favorite portrait into a short video with a gentle head turn or a quiet moment of eye contact.

records.name: Gymfuse
records.tagline: Sync any Bluetooth gym equipment to Strava & Zwift
records.description: Connects Bluetooth gym equipment to Strava, Zwift, Garmin Connect, and Apple Health. Most gym equipment from the last 5-7 years broadcasts data via Bluetooth LE using FTMS. Gymfuse reads this in real time and bridges it live (Zwift) or uploads it as a FIT file when your workout ends. Works with treadmills, rowing machines, bikes, ellipticals, and stair climbers. No pairing codes, no proprietary apps. macOS and Windows. 14-day free trial, no credit card. €7.99/month.

records.name: Buyer Search Map
records.tagline: Turn your buyer's problem into search and content ideas
records.description: Find a starting point for reaching B2B buyers. Enter your product, buyer role and problem to generate Google search ideas, AI-assistant questions, LinkedIn topics and suggested messaging gaps. Free, with no sign-up. Built by The Brand Nest for early-stage founders. These are suggested ideas, not live keyword data or verified competitor research.

records.name: The AI Founder’s Launchpad
records.tagline: A 30-day roadmap to launch your first AI-powered offer
records.description: A 30-day system for solo founders who want an AI-powered offer live without hiring a team. Get the prompts, workflows, and templates to pick an AI service clients already pay for, package it as a simple offer, create content that brings in buyers, and deliver the work faster with AI. Built for freelancers, creators, and first-time founders. Follow the roadmap, use the frameworks, and launch this month instead of collecting more unused courses.

records.name: FLUX 3 Video
records.tagline: Make short AI video from a prompt or a photo
records.description: FLUX 3 Video is an independent site for AI videos in the browser. Write a prompt for text to video, or upload a photo and animate it. Clips can run 2 to 20 seconds, and FLUX 3 and FLUX 3 Max can add dialogue, ambience, and music. The workspace has Video Edit, a video upscaler, Draft Mode, and FLUX 3 Image Klein for stills. New accounts get free credits with no card; paid plans start at $19.90/month and include commercial use. This site is not affiliated with or endorsed by Black Forest Labs.

records.name: Bookify
records.tagline: AI-Powered ERP & Business Automation Platform
records.description: Bookify is an intelligent business operating system that combines ERP, AI, automation and analytics in one platform. It covers sales, inventory, accounting, CRM, HR, procurement and multi-branch management, with AI-driven reporting and predictive insights for smarter real-time decisions. Offline sync keeps your business running without internet and updates data automatically once you reconnect. Built for modern businesses that want to streamline operations and scale efficiently.

records.name: Driftclip
records.tagline: Win+V that remembers everything you copy
records.description: Windows keeps your last 25 copies and wipes them on restart. Driftclip replaces Win+V with a picker that never forgets: text, links, screenshots, files and API keys stay searchable on your PC. Press Win+V, type two letters, hit Enter to paste. Keys are detected and masked, clips remember the app and site they came from, and you can import from Clip Diary or Ditto. Local only, no account.

records.name: go-bot
records.tagline: A self-hosted personal agent with memory and initiative
records.description: go-bot is an open-source, self-hosted personal agent built on a Go Harness—an alternative to Muse, dots and Grok Bot. Search and operate the web, work with Word/PPT/Excel, and create images or video through plugins. Includes long-term memory, cross-chat recall, proactive discoveries and scheduled tasks. Use the web and mobile clients or connect your own frontend. It also provides an out-of-the-box enterprise solution with an independent agent per account on ECI.

records.name: Evenfolio
records.tagline: India, US and UCITS investments, tracked in one place
records.description: Your mutual funds, stocks and ETFs from India, the US and UCITS now live in one place. Evenfolio tracks them together, shows your real XIRR, fund overlap and capital gains, and lets you compare any fund or ETF with its peers. Connect Zerodha, upload a CAS or type your holdings in. Read company concall highlights, rank stocks by momentum and more. Free to use.

records.name: Fresh Home Essential Oil Duo
records.tagline: Tea tree and lemongrass essential oil duo for a fresh home
records.description: Rootsar Fresh Home pairs tea tree and lemongrass essential oils to give your home a fresh smell. The oils are 100% pure.

records.name: Revercue
records.tagline: Proposals, contracts, forms, invoices and CRM in one thread
records.description: Revercue keeps freelancer and small-agency client work in one interactive thread instead of static PDFs and five disconnected tools: proposals with packages and FAQs, versioned contracts with simple e-signature, requirement forms (adaptive on Growth+), invoices with payment links or bank proof uploads, and an auto-building client record.

records.name: APiLOG
records.tagline: Apiary Management Software & Hive App
records.description: APiLOG is a simple, field-friendly digital hive log book for record-keeping beekeepers. Voice record inspections, get AI assistance to organize and track hive health easily.

records.name: CleanPDF Sign PDF
records.tagline: Sign PDFs in your browser. Free, private, no account.
records.description: Draw your signature, type it in one of nine handwriting styles, or upload a photo (the paper background is removed automatically). Add initials to every page, dates, names, ticks and crosses, then drag, resize and save. Your PDF and your signature never leave your device. Free, with no account, no watermark and nothing to install.

records.name: FaculZo
records.tagline: Campus apps for students, staff and security
records.description: FaculZo replaces paper leave slips and gate registers with three connected campus apps. Students get notes, attendance with a bunk calculator, and leave requests that become QR gate passes. Staff post notices and approve leave. Security scans passes at the gate, and teachers get live alerts. Built by Nagendra Global Innovations.

records.name: Webdesly Marina
records.tagline: Fleet, trips and maintenance for yacht operators
records.description: Quiet operator desk for yacht owners and charter desks: fleet status, trips, and maintenance to confirm or complete on a Today desk. Not an owner portfolio, not a yacht marketplace. Free Marina Demo, no signup.

records.name: Data Career School
records.tagline: Data, ML & AI Interview Prep | Projects | AI Mock Interviews
records.description: Data Career School is an interview preparation platform for Data, ML and AI professionals. - Prepare with 300+ company-specific questions across SQL, DSA, AI Engineering, behavioral interviews, business case studies, and more. - Build hands-on projects across Data Science, Machine Learning, and AI using messy, real-world datasets. - Take AI-powered mock interviews to get instant feedback.

records.name: PeptideCompare
records.tagline: Compare peptide prices and independent lab test results
records.description: PeptideCompare checks research-peptide sellers against the evidence. It reads 24,857 listings from 309 vendor sites, compares them by price per milligram, and sets them beside independent lab scores and 6,646 published lab reports, checked against the issuing lab where the lab allows it. 112 compounds carry an A to D grade for how strong the research is. Free, no account needed, and nobody can pay to be listed or ranked higher.

records.name: Signature Ritual Essential Oil Trio
records.tagline: Lavender, frankincense and peppermint essential oil trio
records.description: Rootsar Signature Ritual is a three-oil set pairing soft floral lavender, warm woody frankincense and cool, crisp peppermint. The oils are 100% vegan and 100% natural.

records.name: Raglex
records.tagline: Open-source, native digital asset manager, reference board
records.description: Raglex brings a visual reference library and an infinite moodboard into one fast, free desktop app. Index your existing folders without duplicating files, search by color or offline AI, and clip from the web—on Windows, macOS, and Linux.

records.name: Olympus Coder
records.tagline: Open-source desktop & VPS workbench for 18+ AI coding agents
records.description: Olympus Coder is a free, Apache-2.0 desktop workbench and zero-Electron headless VPS server that unifies Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, Ollama, and 18+ ACP coding agents in one workspace. Switch agents mid-project with shared memory, delegate tasks to parallel sub-sessions in isolated Git worktrees, review per-hunk diffs with 1-click Undo, reset bloated sessions via Fresh Context Carryover, and control runs or live terminals from your phone over local LAN or an E2E-encrypted relay.

records.name: Klaara
records.tagline: YouTube summarizer for Mac
records.description: Klaara is a Mac app that turns YouTube videos into articles with chapters, screenshots and key takeaways. Paste a link and read the video in a minute or two, or open the Watch view to follow it chapter by chapter. Your first 3 summaries are free. After that you pay €19 once and add your own Claude, OpenAI, Grok or Gemini API key, which stays in your Mac's Keychain. A 20-minute video costs from under 1 cent to about $0.34 on your key. There is no subscription.

records.name: Hostavi
records.tagline: One place to run your short-term rentals
records.description: Hostavi is property management software for short-term rental hosts: one calendar for every booking, prices set once for all your channels, a guest inbox with translation, cleanings for your team and your own booking website. Web, iPhone and Android, in 10 languages.

records.name: Codorna Online
records.tagline: An MMORPG where your GitHub stack shapes your pet
records.description: Codorna Online is a free Brazilian pixel-art MMORPG for Windows. Choose from 12 classes and explore villages visited by creatures from Brazilian folklore. Between adventures, fish, mine, or settle into a home. Link your GitHub profile to generate a stack card and discover a pet shaped by the technologies you use.

records.name: Sambung Ayat
records.tagline: Free Quran memorization quiz in 12 languages. No login.
records.description: Practice Quran memorization with 6 quiz modes: continue the ayah, guess the surah or juz, fill in the blank and more. A same-for-everyone daily challenge, teacher links for classes, works offline. Free, no account, no ads, open source.

records.name: Contour: Portfolio Tracker
records.tagline: Track investments from a screenshot, then race your chart
records.description: A calm portfolio tracker for iPhone. Import your holdings from a screenshot of your broker app, then see how your stocks, ETFs, crypto and cash are doing against the market. Ride turns your chart into a bike track. Free for up to 10 assets; Pro unlocks more.

records.name: UnlimitedScrapers
records.tagline: The First unlimited TikTok scraper ever!
records.description: TikTok scraping is ridiculously expensive at scale. I made the solution. UnlimitedScrapers is 40x cheaper than anything on the market.

records.name: Karwa
records.tagline: AI agents that run your hiring, from application to offer
records.description: Karwa is a hiring platform run by AI agents. They screen resumes, phone-interview candidates, take interview notes, schedule, and check claims, then move people through stages. You choose how much they decide: full agentic mode or approvals at key steps.

records.name: The Glow Test
records.tagline: Honest buying guides for at-home beauty devices
records.description: Plain, honest guides to LED face masks, IPL hair removal, red light panels and face tools. Every page starts with a short answer, then who each device suits (and who it doesn't), FDA clearance status, real specs and sources. We also cover the hard questions most sites skip, like laser hair removal on dark skin. Free to read, no sign-up.

records.name: mHUB
records.tagline: One menu bar icon to install & update 28 free Mac apps
records.description: mHUB is the hub of the Desktop Mac Toolkit: 28 free, open source Mac utilities (menu bar tools, PDF, backups, screen recording, icons, clipboard, window switching…). One window lists every app with its installed and latest version: install, update or open it in one click. Downloads come from each app's public GitHub release, and mHUB checks the Developer ID signature and Gatekeeper before replacing anything. Free, MIT, notarized, Apple silicon, macOS 15+, 4 languages.

records.name: Website Development Training
records.tagline: Plan, Build & Launch a Professional Website
records.description: A practical, beginner-friendly training that takes you from website idea to a working website. Learn website planning, domain names and hosting, WordPress setup, design, essential pages and functionality, launch, and ongoing management through guided lessons and hands-on exercises. Build the knowledge and confidence to create professional websites for businesses, portfolio and other real-world needs.

records.name: Website Check by Solucionec
records.tagline: Free website audit: a score out of 10 and what to fix
records.description: Type in your domain and in about a minute get a score out of 10 and a traffic light for each area (SEO, speed, security, email, legal pages and contact), with what to fix first explained without jargon. Checked from the outside: no sign-up and no access to your website. Free, supported by ads.

records.name: Inference Academy
records.tagline: Learn LLM inference engineering with hands-on courses
records.description: Hands-on courses for engineers who want to understand how LLMs run in production and how to make them fast, cheap and safe. Learn why inference is fast or slow from memory bandwidth and GPU architecture, go inside vLLM, SGLang and llama.cpp, and apply quantization, KV caching, batching and speculative decoding.

records.name: DabiSlap
records.tagline: Tap your MacBook for wooden-fish sound and +1 merit
records.description: A $7 macOS menu-bar app for Apple silicon. Gently tap your MacBook to play a wooden fish, earn +1 merit, and take a one-second breath — no account, no cloud, one-time purchase.

records.name: GRE Success
records.tagline: GRE Success, Full-Length GRE Practice Tests & Essay Scoring
records.description: GRE Success provides realistic, section-adaptive practice tests built specifically for the shorter GRE format. Designed as an affordable, unbundled alternative to expensive prep courses, it gives graduate school applicants timed exams, detailed question explanations, and free study tools with no recurring subscriptions.

records.name: VocalRemover
records.tagline: Separate vocals and instrumentals in your browser
records.description: Turn a song into separate vocal and instrumental tracks for karaoke, covers, singing practice, or remixes. Upload your audio, preview both tracks in your browser with independent volume controls, and download either track or both as MP3. Try up to two songs per day without an account. Paid minute packs and subscriptions are available for more processing.

records.name: Operon OS Agenaut
records.tagline: See, control and understand what your AI agents do
records.description: Operon OS Agenaut is where you see, control and understand what your AI agents do. Every action they take through it is shown to you: routine calls just run, risky actions wait for your approval on your phone, and every step leaves a signed receipt.

records.name: Scholix
records.tagline: Websites for schools and coaching institutes, no code needed
records.description: Scholix is an all-in-one digital experience platform designed for educational institutions. Create professional, dynamic websites, showcase courses and campus activities, manage admissions enquiries, and build a stronger online presence — all without technical expertise.

records.name: Kelimoji
records.tagline: A Turkish-language word party game for one phone
records.description: Kelimoji is a fast word-guessing party game in Turkish for friends and family, played on one phone. One player describes the word on the card without saying any of its five forbidden words while the team races the clock. 5,000+ hand-picked Turkish cards across 5 difficulty levels and 122 categories, 2 to 6 teams, and it works fully offline. Free, with no sign-up and no ads mid-round. All cards and the interface are in Turkish.

records.name: UniQR
records.tagline: Free QR code generator with logo, no login, no watermark
records.description: UniQR is a free QR code generator for URLs, WiFi, vCards, restaurant menus and payments (UPI, EasyPaisa/JazzCash, PIX, WeChat Pay) and more. No login required, no watermark on exports, add your own logo to the QR code, download as PNG or SVG. Available in English, Urdu, Hindi, Arabic and Spanish. Part of the free UniSoftware tools suite.

records.name: KoiArt
records.tagline: Christmas is here. On your Mac and PC
records.description: Snow on every window, snowmen on your desktop, Santa riding by, a little train that delivers gifts to your friends, and a Yeti who wants your snowman. Buy once, use forever.

records.name: The Internet Tower
records.tagline: Buy a window in an endless skyscraper. Rank by what you pay.
records.description: An endless night skyscraper built by the internet, just for fun. Every window is an apartment: pay to claim one with your name, logo and link. Rank = total you've paid; the top spot is the rooftop billboard (Penthouse #0). Want to overtake someone? Pay a bit more. Browsing is free; join via web (card) or Telegram (Stars Mini App). A tiny, honest, silly piece of internet real estate.

records.name: Baker Research
records.tagline: Understand businesses, not just share prices.
records.description: Baker Research makes financial research accessible to everyday investors and businesses. Explore reported financial data, intuitive Business Health indicators, balanced bull and bear evidence, interactive valuation models and historical company performance. Build watchlists, test your own assumptions and develop independent research without expensive subscriptions. Start for free or unlock enhanced research tools for just £4.99/month.

records.name: Topside
records.tagline: Every agent, one notch.
records.description: Your Mac is an airport. Your coding agents are the pilots flying your tasks. Topside is the departure board in the notch: who's flying, who's waiting on you, and ⌃Y to clear one for takeoff. Prefer a restaurant? Flip it to a kitchen printing order tickets. Claude Code, Codex CLI, pi, omp, OpenCode. Free, on Arch Linux too.

records.name: Wikishopline
records.tagline: Discover stores, compare products and find better deals
records.description: Wikishopline brings online shopping discovery into one place. Explore merchants, compare products across stores and discover deals, alongside travel, digital goods and useful tools. Free to browse, with no account required.

records.name: BentoBuddy: Meal & Water Track
records.tagline: Stop Skipping Meals at Work. Eat Better, Every Day.
records.description: You sit down to work, look up, and it's 4 pm with no lunch. Reminders don't help, because you swipe them away. BentoBuddy does more than remind. At mealtime it pauses your Mac with a full-screen break, and the way back is to snap a photo of your meal on your iPhone. Photos are checked on-device and never saved. Choose how strict it is (Casual, Medium or Hardcore), log water in one tap, and keep a meal schedule that fits your day.

records.name: Sendlore
records.tagline: Save links with context, then ask what you saved
records.description: Sendlore is a personal AI bookmark manager for links, notes and files. Save the source and why it mattered to you, then find it later by describing a detail you remember, not the title. Ask questions across your library and get answers that link straight back to the sources behind them. Free plan; Plus $9, Pro $19 and Max $39/month.

records.name: 24LittleGifts
records.tagline: A personalised digital advent calendar to give as a gift
records.description: Fill 24 doors with photos, letters, songs, vouchers and videos, send one private link, and they open one door a day from Dec 1. No app or account needed for the person receiving it. Future doors stay locked on the server, so changing the phone's date won't open them early. In Spanish and English. From €4.99, one-time payment.

records.name: The Self Care Products
records.tagline: Hand-picked self-care finds for slow evenings at home
records.description: A small self-care shop for women: 320 picks across bath, skin, sleep, hair, nails and cozy home, plus 14 gift collections. Every pick comes with a short note on why it's there and who it suits.

records.name: Shopproof
records.tagline: EU withdrawal button and product safety for online shops
records.description: Since 19 June 2026, shops selling to EU consumers need a withdrawal button. Shopproof adds it to Shopify, WooCommerce and Shopware, with the confirmation email, product safety (GPSR) details and the EU guarantee notice, in 24 EU languages. New: set it up by talking to your AI assistant, with a preview and an undo for every change. The free version has no product limit and nothing locked. Pro alerts you when a rule changes where you sell. Technical help, not legal advice.

records.name: Ink & Meaning
records.tagline: Free Chinese Tattoo Meanings & Fonts
records.description: Ink & Meaning helps you explore Chinese expressions for tattoos with meaning and cultural context. Ask the AI guide to explain Chinese text or a photo, translate an English phrase, or suggest expressions around a theme. Browse the word library, preview Chinese typefaces, switch between horizontal and vertical layouts, and download your composition as a PNG. Free to use, with no account required.

records.name: Tutorials Kit
records.tagline: Your agent keeps your tutorial videos in sync with your app
records.description: Open-source CLI your coding agent uses to turn your app's workflows into narrated tutorial videos and written guides. One prompt in Claude Code, Cursor or Codex sets it up: it writes Playwright flows, records your app, narrates with ElevenLabs and renders with Remotion. Each time you ship a change, your agent runs check to find the tutorials that broke and rebuilds just those. MIT, runs locally, bring your own keys.

records.name: ShortFlowAI
records.tagline: Faceless channels that post every day
records.description: ShortFlowAI runs a faceless channel for you on YouTube Shorts, TikTok and Reels. Pick a format and a topic, and every day it produces a finished short: script, visuals, voice and subtitles. You approve each episode on your phone, or switch on autopilot and let it build by itself. Built for creators and small teams who want a daily channel without filming or editing. First video free.

records.name: Festively
records.tagline: Find local festivals and events for your travel dates
records.description: Festively helps you discover festivals, traditions and unique experiences, so you can plan the trip around what you want to live. Explore a map with filters for country, month and style. Save events, rate experiences, create shareable trips and talk to the assistant to find the plan that fits you. Festively is not a travel agency or a booking platform. It is a tool for discovery and inspiration. There are no payments or bookings in the app.

records.name: openers
records.tagline: the question card game that only works in person
records.description: put the phone on the table, draw a card, answer out loud. 60+ decks for dates, friends and family. 10,000 questions in 13 languages. on iphone, it can even write you a fresh deck with no wifi.

records.name: stillorigin
records.tagline: A firewall for web hosts, on servers you run
records.description: A firewall built for web hosts. You run the sentries in front of any server, Linux or Windows, so visitor traffic flows only through your servers. Every domain gets Network protection. Website protection is opt-in, per domain, and starts in log mode so you see what would be blocked first. Search engines and AI crawlers are verified by their published IP ranges. Start a 30-day free trial.

records.name: 6SQ Tools
records.tagline: Free browser-based SPC, Cpk and MSA calculators
records.description: 150+ quality and statistics calculators that run in your browser: SPC charts, Cp/Cpk capability, Gage R&R (MSA), AQL sampling, DPMO and DOE. No signup, no install, and your measurement data never leaves the tab.

records.name: Watchfront
records.tagline: Free website down checker + monitoring for agencies
records.description: Need to know if a site is down right now? Use the free website down checker — no signup. Then monitor client sites continuously: uptime, SSL expiry, broken contact forms, SEO regressions and JS errors, with reports clients renew on. Built for agencies and WordPress care plans. Free checkers forever; full monitoring free for 3 days, no card.

records.name: Growth Studio by PixVerse
records.tagline: Video ads from platform- and category-specific templates
records.description: Less prompting. More selling. Turn product photos into video ads without the cost of a shoot or hours of editing. PixVerse Growth Studio helps ecommerce brands and marketing teams create more content with carefully crafted templates and streamlined workflows. Each template is designed for specific product categories, platforms, and ad placements—from the opening hook to the product story and call to action. Pick a template, add your product, and customize a few details to generate your ad.

records.name: ChatCommerce
records.tagline: Your customers ask AI where to buy. See who it names
records.description: Your customers ask AI where to buy. Add your store URL, create your account, and watch ChatCommerce question ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI, Claude and Grok (and Gemini on Pro) in your dashboard, or from Claude and ChatGPT via MCP: are you named, and what to fix first.

records.name: Snag by Parallel
records.tagline: Find the best deals on products from your agents
records.description: Find the best deals on the products you've been asking ChatGPT, Claude, and other agents about. Snag turns those conversations into a wishlist you import in one click, matches each item to the exact product, and checks prices across stores. Lists are sorted by best deal, every price is rated against its list price, and any list can be shared with a link. 100% free, in time for Black Friday. Powered by the Parallel Shopping API and Parallel Images API.

records.name: PeerBand
records.tagline: Reach every coding agent you run, from anywhere
records.description: Connect the coding agents you run in Herdr across your laptop, desktop, and VMs. Check what they’re working on from ChatGPT or another MCP client. Get a Telegram message when an agent needs you, then reply to that exact agent from your phone. Install PeerBand on each machine and reach your agents without SSH.

records.name: Omi X 2.0
records.tagline: Omi can build anything. Your $1B idea, live in production
records.description: Omi can build anything. Omi X 2.0 is the desktop app for Mac and Windows that builds a production AI SaaS on your own Google Cloud and Firebase. New in 2.0: Point and edit lets you click any part of your running app and tell Omi what to change. Open an existing project brings in your own Next.js app; Omi tests, builds and deploys it. New projects start from a tested starter. Plan free, no card; building from $29 a month.

records.name: Notely
records.tagline: Notion-grade power & BYOK AI, stored locally in SQLite
records.description: Ditch $120/yr note subscriptions. Notely is a 100% offline-first Windows 11 workspace backed by SQLite WAL + FTS5 search—no accounts, no telemetry, free forever. Open up to 24 Chrome-style tabs, write rich notes with resizable tables, sticky notes, built-in calculator & live inline stopwatch timers, compare word-level version history, lock sensitive notes with Argon2id + AES-256-GCM, export losslessnotely/PDF via Print Studio, and opt in to BYOK Gemini or GroqCloud AI.

records.name: Klavia
records.tagline: Multiplayer Typing Races with a Competitive Twist
records.description: Klavia is a free-to-play multiplayer typing racing game packed with personality! Compete in fast-paced races, join a team and battle for supremacy in the Klavia Typing League, complete quests, and unlock pixel-art vehicles, adorable pets, and countless collectibles. With seasonal competitions, leaderboards, and community-created content, there's always something new to discover. Whether you're a casual typist or a competitive racer, Klavia makes improving your typing skills fun and rewarding!

records.name: gratis
records.tagline: Use open source AI models locally for free in a few clicks.
records.description: gratis runs open source AI models privately on your own machine, inside a browser tab or downloadable app, in just a few clicks. Free, with no usage limits. Pick a model from the catalogue or load any GGUF model from Hugging Face. gratis downloads it to your device and runs the model there. Browsers cap WebAssembly memory at 4GB, below what a useful model needs. We forked the inference runtime onto 64-bit addressing to reach 16GB, which is why a model of real size fits in a tab.

records.name: Flowfixd
records.tagline: Field Service Management Software for Small Teams
records.description: Run your whole service business in one place: leads, estimates, scheduling, dispatch, jobs and invoices for HVAC, plumbing, electrical, cleaning and landscaping teams. Connect Claude, ChatGPT or any MCP agent to add leads, draft estimates and chase payments — with your approval before anything reaches a customer. Free plan, no credit card.

records.name: Fishing Codex
records.tagline: Free fishing logbook. Anglers decide who gets their catch
records.description: Fishing Codex is a free fishing app for iPhone and Android. Log a catch and the tide, moon and weather fill in, even for old photos. Your map is private and works with no signal. It checks the coming days against your best catches and shows which ones line up. You decide what to publish, free or at your own price; whoever claims or buys an entry gets the exact place on their private map. The public map shows heat areas. Crews and events worldwide, and a free Directory for guides.

records.name: Statefold
records.tagline: Coding agents that keep working while you're away
records.description: Statefold runs your coding agent (Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, Pi or Gemini CLI) on its own cloud computer, so it keeps working after you close your laptop. Give it a task and it writes the code, tests it and opens a pull request. If a check fails or a reviewer leaves a comment, the agent sees it and fixes it in the same conversation. Review the changes and merge from your computer or your phone. It works with the subscription or API key you already pay for.

records.name: Lume
records.tagline: Play your PC games anywhere. Low latency. Plug & Play.
records.description: Play your PC games on your phone, tablet or browser. Low latency, image quality and plug-and-play setup. Published glass-to-glass tests. No port forwarding or VPN. Free locally; paid remote play, one-month money-back guarantee coming soon. Joue à tes jeux PC partout. Faible latence, qualité d'image et plug & play. Essais verre-à-verre publiés. Sans port à ouvrir ni VPN. Gratuit en local, abonnement à distance, bientôt un mois satisfait ou remboursé.

records.name: NielloPlayer
records.tagline: Turn Your Old Phone Into an MP3 Player
records.description: NielloPlayer is a black-and-gold music player for Android. It turns an old phone into a full-featured music player — one that is still worth using as a dedicated player instead of leaving it in a drawer. It plays the formats you probably already have: FLAC, DSD, MP3 and more. Everything is decoded on the phone. There is gapless playback, ReplayGain, a 31-band equalizer, and USB DAC output with exclusive mode if you have external audio hardware. Getting music onto the phone does not need a cable.

records.name: BuySellNames
records.tagline: Buy and sell .com, .ai, .si and premium domain names.
records.description: BuySellNames is a marketplace built only for domain names. Browsecom,ai,si and premium names for sale, list your own domain in minutes, and deal directly with buyers and sellers - buy it now, make an offer, or message the seller. 100% free to access and no payment required.

records.name: OddForge LaunchCheck
records.tagline: Check ZIP packages before sharing or selling
records.description: LaunchCheck is an offline ZIP preflight checker for digital creators, developers and sellers. Review the contents and structure of a ZIP package, flag possible packaging issues and download a findings report before distributing files. It's a packaging check, not an antivirus or malware scanner. Runs in a modern desktop browser. £9.99 one-time purchase, no subscription.

records.name: LanDock
records.tagline: LanDock turns your phone into a control panel for your PC.
records.description: LanDock turns your phone into a fully customizable control panel for your PC. All communication takes place exclusively over your local Wi-Fi network (LAN) — no cloud servers, no account registration, and no sending your data to third parties. LanDock makes interacting with your computer easier. OBS integration Switch scenes, mute your mic, start/stop your stream, adjust audio levels, and trigger custom shortcuts — all from a fully customizable control panel on your phone.

records.name: Security Audit
records.tagline: Website security scan that goes beyond Mozilla Observatory
records.description: A passive scan of any public site: security headers, TLS via a real handshake, cookies, mixed content, known CVEs from the NIST NVD, mail DNS, CAA and DNSSEC. Built on Observatory's header checks with eleven more check families, scored from 100 down by real risk, with a plain-English fix for each finding.

records.name: ChessDhaara
records.tagline: Chess academy management app for India
records.description: ChessDhaara is a white-label app for chess academies. Coaches track attendance and fees, set puzzle homework and run a rewards shop. Students level up from Pawn to King with XP and coins, and parents get a weekly report in English or Hindi.

records.name: Oculon
records.tagline: The agentic finance platform for the CFO's office
records.description: Oculon is the agentic finance platform powered by agents that run complete workflows, with precision and control. From forecasts and variance analysis to reporting and data ops, connect tools like QuickBooks, Xero, Zoho Books, HubSpot, Salesforce, and agents build your first model in 10 minutes. Every agent works from a living context of your business, every number drills back to its source, and every action is brought back to you for approval. Compliant with SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, GDPR.

records.name: PLOMA Studio
records.tagline: Audio Mastering & AI Track Rescue
records.description: Ploma is a high-speed, browser-native audio mastering and track rescue engine built for modern music producers and AI creators. Unlike traditional cloud mastering platforms, Ploma processes everything locally in your browser in under 0.8 seconds—meaning 0 B of your unreleased music ever leaves your device.

records.name: PingPong Live by WSOS
records.tagline: Browser live streaming with a teleprompter and AI presenter
records.description: Go live from your browser with no download. Built in: a teleprompter, an AI presenter that reads your script, copyright-free music, DJ song requests, live shopping and OBS multistreaming. Viewers need no app. Keep 85% of gifts and sales. No plan needed.
